claims.statement: The Met’s chronology places Lapita settlement of Island Melanesia and western Polynesia around 1500–500 BCE.
Communities expanded eastward across the western Pacific and made distinctively decorated pottery.

evidence.locator: Timeline; Overview; Key Events for Arnhem Land and Lapita
evidence.note: Broad source-specific chronology. Islands were settled at different times; this band is not an annual migration route or territorial boundary. Geographic associations need further research.
